Every day brings a new conflict, a new war, a new tariff battle, or another geopolitical ego clash. One day it’s Trump shaking global trade, the next it’s Putin expanding influence, China pushing boundaries, or instability erupting in the Middle East.

We were told the world was stable — that international law, the UN, and diplomacy would prevent chaos. But what we are witnessing today feels different. Power is replacing principles. Strong nations are acting aggressively, global institutions appear weaker, and the world economy is constantly on edge. Layoffs, inflation, AI threatening jobs, stock market shocks, and regime changes across multiple regions show that instability is no longer local — it’s global.

In this video, we explore whether this is just a temporary phase or the collapse of the old world order, and where India stands in this shifting power game. This is not about fear or propaganda — it’s about clarity.

Watch till the end before forming an opinion.
